structDefaultsEvidence: MGetKV3ClassDefaults of each struct, called in-process; CParticleFloatInput ctor 0x1803837b0 (literal value = 2nd arg via InitLiteral 0x180384040 which writes m_nType=LITERAL, m_nMapType=DIRECT, m_flLiteralValue=arg); CParticleVecInput ctor 0x18038d330
statisticsNote: Inside input structs the stock corpus writes every sub-field (41037 of 44095 float inputs are full form, the rest are the compact {m_nType, m_flLiteralValue} literal form), so here the per-sub-field mode is a real statistic: for every scalar sub-field it equals the KV3 default. The four nested CParticleFloatInput members of the vector input differ only because old files lack sub-fields added later (m_bReverseOrder, m_nRandomSeed, m_strSnapshotSubset, m_flNoCameraFallback, m_bUseBoundsCenter, m_nRoundType, m_flCompareValue).

collectionFields.note: CParticleCollection offsets read by the evaluators (not schema-bound; from the decompiles cited)
collectionFields.0x20/0x30: first child collection / next sibling (SetControlPoint* propagate to every child recursively)
collectionFields.0x50: current time: set to -preSimTime at Init (0x180038c20), += dt each frame (0x180047af9)
collectionFields.0x60: operator time origin (operator time = max(0, curTime - this))
collectionFields.0x68: previous non-zero dt (written only when dt != 0, 0x180047adb)
collectionFields.0x168/0x170: CP index -> slot byte table / control point array (0xE0 bytes each)
collectionFields.0x2d8 + 8*i: attribute i stream (current); 0x460 + i = its stride byte (>>2 = 16-byte blocks per 4 particles)
collectionFields.0x4c8 + 8*i: attribute i initial-value stream; 0x650 + i = its stride
collectionFields.0x910/0x914/0x918: random-table counter / per-collection random seed offset / per-frame op seed

controlPoint(0xE0).0x94: last change time (FLT -1.0 sentinel = never set)

randomTable.VARYING: r = T[(coll.0x914 + coll.0x910++) & 0xfff]  (a new draw every evaluation)
randomTable.CONSTANT_collection: r = T[(coll.0x914 + seed) & 0xfff], seed = opSeedBlock[input+0x88] + coll.0x918
randomTable.signFlipDraw: second draw at +0x25 (constant) or next counter (varying); flip when r2 < 0.5
randomTable.status: UNSETTLED for bit-exact reproduction: the table contents and seed block are runtime data (not extracted); the rule is settled, the numbers are not

dispatch.rule: An input is evaluated into a 4-wide stream ctx. FUN_18005b3b0 (0x18005b3b0) reads m_nType and m_nMapType and writes the map mode at ctx+0x60; FUN_18005ad90 (0x18005ad90) then calls one of ten evaluators by map mode. Collection inputs use lane 0 only (collection loops read *stream).
dispatch.typeOverridesMap: PF_TYPE_RANDOM_UNIFORM forces map mode REMAP with in=[0,1], out=[m_flRandomMin, m_flRandomMax]; PF_TYPE_RANDOM_BIASED forces REMAP_BIASED with the same ranges and m_nBiasType/m_flBiasParameter. m_nMapType is ignored for both (0x18005b3b0).
dispatch.literalBypass: PF_TYPE_LITERAL returns m_flLiteralValue unchanged under EVERY map mode (case 0 of all ten evaluators): m_flMultFactor, remap, curve and notch are never applied to a literal.
dispatch.initializerSubstitution: When the owning function is an initializer (vfunc +0xd0 returns 2; 0x1800b8920; operators return 0, emitters 1) PF_TYPE_PARTICLE_INITIAL_FLOAT(22)->PARTICLE_FLOAT(21) and PARTICLE_INITIAL_VECTOR_COMPONENT(24)->PARTICLE_VECTOR_COMPONENT(23) (0x18005acd0).
dispatch.collectionOnlyTypes: For a collection-level evaluation types outside {0..8,10..18} yield 0 (0x18005ad90 switch).

sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_RANDOM_UNIFORM (2): r from the random table (see randomTable), then REMAP [0,1]->[min,max] clamped to [min(min,max), max(min,max)], then sign flip if m_bHasRandomSignFlip and r2 < 0.5 (flip applied AFTER remap+clamp, 0x180090850)
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_COLLECTION_AGE (4): coll.curTime(+0x50) - ctx+0x6c; ctx+0x6c is 0 at every call site read, so = collection time since start
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_PARTICLE_DETAIL_LEVEL (10): m_flLOD0..3 selected by global detail level (0x1803845a0); NOT mapped under CURVE (broadcast as-is, 0x18005f1a2)
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_CONCURRENT_DEF_COUNT (11): (float) definition.0x3b8. Incremented (lock inc) in CParticleCollection::Init 0x180038c20 (0x180039298) for every collection created from this definition, decremented on shutdown 0x18003c5c0 unless emission is stopped, decremented when emission stops and re-incremented when it restarts (0x1800486e0, flag 8 at coll+0x8bc). So: the number of live collections of this .vpcf definition, game-wide, whose emission is not stopped, including the evaluating one.
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_CLOSEST_CAMERA_DISTANCE (12): root collection +0x8c8 (requests it via flag 0x8c2|=2); -1 sentinel -> m_flNoCameraFallback
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_SNAPSHOT_COUNT (13): snapshot particle count (0 if no snapshot CP)
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_PARTICLE_AGE_NORMALIZED (20): (curTime - creationTime) / attr1(Life Duration); lifetime <= 0 -> 0. Not clamped to [0,1] in the source; clamping comes from the map mode.
sourceTypes.PF_TYPE_PARTICLE_FLOAT (21): attribute m_nScalarAttribute (+0x64); angle attributes x57.29578, int attributes int->float

mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_MULT (1): value = source * m_flMultFactor (m_flMultFactor is used by no other map type)
mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_REMAP (2): x = source; if m_nInputMode == LOOPED: x = (x/in1 - floor(x/in1)) * in1 (period is m_flInput1 alone, not in1-in0); t = (in1 == in0) ? (x >= in0 ? 1 : 0) : (x - in0)/(in1 - in0); value = clamp(out0 + t*(out1 - out0), min(out0,out1), max(out0,out1))
mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_REMAP_BIASED (3): as REMAP to t, then t = min(t,1), t = Bias(t), value = clamp(out0 + t*(out1-out0), lo, hi)
mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_CURVE (4): x = source; if LOOPED: x = frac(x/P)*P with P = m_Curve.m_vDomainMaxs.x; value = curve(x)
mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_NOTCHED (5): value = (min(m_flNotchedRangeMin,Max) <= x <= max(...)) ? m_flNotchedOutputInside : m_flNotchedOutputOutside (both ends inclusive; m_nInputMode not applied)
mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_ROUND (6): NEAREST = cvtps2dq (round half to even), FLOOR = roundps 1, CEIL = roundps 2 (m_nRoundType)
mapTypes.PF_MAP_TYPE_MOD (9): x - trunc(x / m_flCompareValue) * m_flCompareValue (C fmod sign rule)
mapTypes.inputMode: m_nInputMode is read only by REMAP, REMAP_BIASED and CURVE (0x18005da90, 0x18005e500, 0x18005f130); CLAMPED clamps via the output clamp, LOOPED wraps the input as above
mapTypes.setup: remap constants written by FUN_18005b5b0(ctx, mapType, biasType, in0, in1, out0, out1, biasParam) at 0x18005b5b0 (argument registers confirmed in the disassembly at 0x18005b55a)

bias.precompute (0x18005b5b0): STANDARD/GAIN: b = clamp((m_flBiasParameter + 1) * 0.5, 0, 1); b <= 0 or b >= 1 -> constant t = 0 or 1; else k = 1/b - 2. EXPONENTIAL: p >= 0 -> e = 1 - clamp(p,0,1); p < 0 -> e = 20 - 19*clamp(p+1,0,1)
bias.apply (0x18006f1e0): STANDARD: t/((1-t)*k + 1). GAIN: t < 0.5 ? 0.5*Bias(2t) : 1 - 0.5*Bias(2-2t). EXPONENTIAL: e <= 0 -> 1; else t^e (log/exp pair, clamped min(e,20)); t <= 0 -> 0, t >= 1 -> 1

curve.rule: fewer than 2 points -> 0. Points are {x, y, m_flSlopeIncoming, m_flSlopeOutgoing}. Binary search for the segment, t = clamp((x - x0)/dx, 0, 1) (dx == 0 -> no divide), Hermite: y = y0 + m0*dx*t + (3dy - (2m0 + m1)dx) t^2 + ((m0 + m1)dx - 2dy) t^3 with m0 = p0.SlopeOutgoing, m1 = p1.SlopeIncoming; result clamped to [m_vDomainMins.y, m_vDomainMaxs.y]. m_tangents is editor data, unused at runtime.

floatInput.notched: value = (min(m_flNotchedRangeMin,Max) <= x <= max(...)) ? m_flNotchedOutputInside : m_flNotchedOutputOutside (both ends inclusive; m_nInputMode not applied)
floatInput.multFactor: Only PF_MAP_TYPE_MULT applies m_flMultFactor; no offset term exists in any map type (offsets are expressed as out0/out1).

types.PVEC_TYPE_LITERAL_COLOR (1): (r,g,b) of m_LiteralColor * (1/255) (0.0039216); alpha ignored; then treated as a literal
types.PVEC_TYPE_NAMED_VALUE (2): named value (m_bFollowNamedValue selects the follow variant)
types.PVEC_TYPE_CP_RELATIVE_POSITION (8): CP matrix (forward, left, up, pos) * m_vCPRelativePosition
types.PVEC_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPONENTS (11): (m_FloatComponentX, Y, Z) each a float input stream
types.PVEC_TYPE_FLOAT_INTERP_CLAMPED (12): t = clamp((f - m_flInterpInput0)/(m_flInterpInput1 - m_flInterpInput0), 0, 1); v = m_vInterpOutput0 + t*(m_vInterpOutput1 - m_vInterpOutput0); f = m_FloatInterp; no guard when input1 == input0
types.PVEC_TYPE_FLOAT_INTERP_GRADIENT (14): t as OPEN, then m_Gradient sampled at t (0x1800c2070)
types.PVEC_TYPE_RANDOM_UNIFORM (15) / OFFSET (: UNSETTLED: min + r*(max-min) per component is visible for one lane only in the decompile (0x1800c1c70); not verified in the disassembly

shouldRun (0x18003f820): skip if m_bDisableOperator; tools-state check (m_nToolsState) applies only with a tools context
m_nOpEndCapState: -1 always; 0 only when not in endcap; 1 only in endcap (coll+0x8c1 bit 6)
strength s = m_flOpStrength (collection input). If no fade times are configured (op+0x1b9 precomputed) or s <= 0, strength = s

else t = operator time; a=StartFadeIn, b=max(EndFadeIn,a), c=max(StartFadeOut,b), d=max(EndFadeOut,c) (using raw EndFadeOut for the cut-off): t < a -> 0; raw EndFadeOut > 0 and t > it -> 0; f = 1; if t < b and a < b: f = min(1,(t-a)/(b-a)); if c < t and c < d: f = min(f,(t-d)/(c-d)); strength = max(0,s)*f
operator runs only when strength > 0; strength is passed to Operate as xmm2
operatorTime (0x18003f6e0): if m_bNormalizeToStopTime and m_nOpEndCapState == ENDCAP_ON: t = max(0, t - endcapStart)
if m_nOpTimeOffsetSeed != 0: t = max(0, t + lerp(OffsetMin, OffsetMax, T[(c914 + seed) & 0xfff]))
if m_nOpTimeScaleSeed != 0 and t > StartFadeIn: t = StartFadeIn + (t - StartFadeIn) / max(1e-4, lerp(ScaleMin, ScaleMax, T[(c914+seed)&0xfff]))
if m_flOpFadeOscillatePeriod > 0: t = fmod(curTime / period, 1.0) (absolute curTime, replaces everything above)
operatorStrengthAndTime.preEmissionRunOnce: The per-frame pre-emission loop (0x180047cb0..0x180047f3f) skips operators with m_bRunOnce (CParticleFunctionPreEmission+0x1e0) set. UNSETTLED: where run-once pre-emission operators are executed was not located.

math: radius = 0; pos = query->GetLocalPlayerPos(owner, m_nPosition, &radius)  (IParticleSystemQuery slot 17 / +0x88)
SetControlPointPosition(m_nCP1, pos + m_vecCP1Pos) (0x1800364e0, propagates to every child collection)
if m_nPosition == PARTICLE_FLASHLIGHT: SetControlPointField(m_nRadiusCP, m_nRadiusCPField, radius)

xf = query->GetLocalPlayerEyeTransform(owner, !m_bOrientToEyes) (slot 19 / +0x98); (fwd,left,up) = rotate (1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1) by xf.rotation (0x180360de0); SetControlPointOrientationFLU(m_nCP1, fwd, left, up) (0x18003ec90)

client (client.dll CParticleSystemQuery.GetLocalPlayerPos 0x180a47d10: pawn = owner if it is a player pawn else the local player. ABS_ORIGIN -> GetAbsOrigin; WORLDSPACE_CENTER -> vfunc +0x2b0 (WorldSpaceCenter); EYES -> vfunc +0x568 (EyePosition); FLASHLIGHT and anything else -> (0,0,0). The radius out-parameter is never written, so the radius field is set to 0.

Interpretation of 0x181748070 as an up-vector re-basis is from its decompile (cross products with (0,0,1) then matrix->quaternion); UNSETTLED in detail.

math: per-instance ctx: [0] collision group, [1] next update time. If curTime < next: return. next = m_flUpdateRate >= 0 ? curTime + m_flUpdateRate : FLT_MAX
dir = m_vecTraceDir; if dir == 0: dir = CP[m_nCPIn].forward (previous-frame forward when curTime == curTime - dt in float)
len = m_flTraceLength (collection input). mask = m_bIncludeWater ? 0xdb001 : 0xc3001; trace set ALL/STATIC/STATIC_AND_KEYFRAMED/DYNAMIC -> 0xf/1/3/6
normal mode: start = CP[m_nCPIn].pos + dir*m_flStartOffset; end = start + dir*len; query->TraceLine (slot 4 / +0x20)
m_bTraceToClosestSurface: trace from CP pos (+StartOffset along each axis) along the six axes (+-X,+-Y,+-Z, table 0x1805c0450) of length len and keep the hit closest to the CP

hit (fraction < 1) or m_bSetToEndpoint: pos = trace.endpos - dir*m_flOffset; SetControlPointPosition(m_nCPOut, pos); orientation FLU = (n, cross(Z,n)/|..|, cross(n, left)) with n = trace plane normal (VectorVectors 0x18035ed10; n vertical -> left=(0,1,0), up=(-n.z,0,0))
no hit and not SetToEndpoint: if m_vecTraceDir != 0 the orientation of m_nCPOut is set from -m_vecTraceDir the same way; position unchanged; if m_vecTraceDir == 0 nothing is written
C_OP_SetControlPointToImpactPoint.webNote: needs a world trace; without one only the m_bSetToEndpoint (fraction 1, endpos = end) behaviour can be reproduced exactly

math: m_bSetOnce: run once per instance (ctx flag)
target collection: m_nSetParent NO -> self, IMMEDIATE -> parent, ROOT -> top-most parent
d = |CP[m_nStartCP].pos - CP[m_nEndCP].pos|

m_bLOS: trace start -> (m_flMaxTraceLength != -1 and < d ? start + normalize(CP[end].pos)*MaxTraceLength : CP[end].pos); NOTE the code normalises the END POSITION vector, not (end - start); if fraction != 1: d = d * fraction * m_flLOSScale
out = (m_flInputMin == m_flInputMax) ? (d - m_flInputMax < 0 ? m_flOutputMin : m_flOutputMax) : m_flOutputMin + clamp((d - InputMin)/(InputMax - InputMin), 0, 1)*(m_flOutputMax - m_flOutputMin)

SetControlPointField(target, m_nOutputCP, m_nOutputCPField, out) (0x1802744e0: field 0..2 = x/y/z of the CP position, starting from (0,0,0) if the CP was never set; field 3 is accepted and discarded; children updated)
a = m_flInput1, b = m_flInput2 (collection inputs, lane 0)
r: ADD a+b, SUBTRACT a-b, MUL a*b, DIVIDE b==0 ? 0 : a/b, INPUT_1 a, MIN minss(a,b), MAX maxss(a,b), MOD fmodf(a,b), EQUAL a==b ?1:0, GT a>b ?1:0, LT a<b ?1:0, other 0 (jump table 0x1802783ec)

r is mapped by m_flOutputRemap (CParticleRemapFloatInput, map type only, jump table 0x180278418): DIRECT none, MULT r*m_flMultFactor, REMAP/REMAP_BIASED/CURVE/NOTCHED/ROUND/MIN/MAX/MOD exactly as for float inputs
i = m_flInterpolation; if i != 1.0: r = RemapValClamped(i, 0, 1, currentField, r) = currentField + clamp(i,0,1)*(r - currentField) (0x180059680; currentField read by 0x180122f70)
SetControlPointField(m_nOutputCP, m_nOutVectorField, r)
a = m_vInput1, b = m_vInput2 (per-particle vector inputs), s = operator strength

r: ADD a+b, SUB a-b, MUL a*b, DIVIDE a * rcp(b) where rcp is rcpps + one Newton step and any |b_i| < FLT_MIN has FLT_EPSILON OR-ed into its bits (b=0 -> 1.19e-7), INPUT_1 a, MIN/MAX componentwise, CROSSPRODUCT cross(a,b), LERP a + clamp(m_flLerp,0,1)*(b-a) (jump table 0x180204fbc)
r = r * s (every expression, before the set method)
set method on attribute m_nOutputField: REPLACE r; SCALE_INITIAL r*init; ADD_TO_INITIAL r+init; RAMP_CURRENT cur + r*dt; SCALE_CURRENT r*cur; ADD_TO_CURRENT r+cur
if the output attribute is in mask 0xc100c0 (Color 6, Alpha 7, Alpha Alternate 16, Glow RGB 22, Glow Alpha 23) clamp to the per-op min/max (op+0x1120 / +0x1150, set at init)
m_bNormalizedOutput: r *= rsqrtps(|r|^2 with the same tiny-value guard) (approximate, no Newton step)
kill particle when attr7(Alpha) * attr16(Alpha Alternate) <= m_flMinAlpha + FLT_EPSILON (1.1920929e-7)
kill when lifetime <= 0 or lifetime <= curTime - creationTime (m_bRopeDecay selects a rope-aware variant, not decoded)

init: clamp [lo,hi]: output in Alpha/Alpha Alternate -> [0,1]; Radius/Trail Length -> [0,FLT_MAX]; else [-FLT_MAX,FLT_MAX]
k = 1; if output is Roll/Roll Speed/Yaw/Pitch and method is not SCALE_INITIAL/SCALE_CURRENT: k = 0.0174533 (degrees -> radians)
math: v = m_InputValue, L = clamp(m_Lerp, 0, 1), s = strength, cur = current value, init = initial value
REPLACE: o = cur + L*(k v - cur); clamp; s < 1 -> o = o*s + cur*(1-s)
SCALE_INITIAL: o = cur + L*(k v init - cur); clamp; s < 1 -> o = o*s + init*(1-s)
ADD_TO_INITIAL: o = cur + L*((k v + init) - cur); clamp; s < 1 -> o*s + init*(1-s)
RAMP_CURRENT: o = cur + L * v * (s * k * dt); clamp (no strength blend)
SCALE_CURRENT: o = cur + L*(k v cur - cur); clamp; s < 1 -> o*s + cur*(1-s)
ADD_TO_CURRENT: o = cur + L*((k v + cur) - cur); clamp; s < 1 -> o*s + cur*(1-s)
mn = m_vecMin, mx = m_vecMax (per-particle vector inputs); cp = clamp(m_nControlPointNumber, 0, 63)

offset = (mx - mn) * (r0, r1, r2): if !m_randomnessParameters.m_bDistributeEvenly, r_i = T[(c910 + 2*c914 + i) & 0xfff] (c914 is added twice in the code) and c910 += 3; else Halton(index = (m_nSeed < 0 ? m_nSeed + c914 : m_nSeed) + particleIndex, masked 0x7fffffff) with base 2 for x, 3 for y, 5 for z
!m_bLocalSpace: p = cpPosAtCreation + mn + offset, where cpPosAtCreation = prevPos + (pos - prevPos) * max(0,(dt - (curTime - creationTime))/dt) (dt == 0 -> pos); the box is world-axis aligned

m_bLocalSpace: M = GetControlPointTransformAtTime(cp, creationTime) (0x1800c1e70: interpolated position, current orientation columns forward/left/up); p = M * (mn + offset): local x = forward, y = left, z = up
writes Position and, if the init flags request it (flag 4), Position Previous = p
return if m_TransformInput is CONTROL_POINT and that CP was never set (flags & 0x1d == 0)
T = transform from m_TransformInput; P = T.position. Per-instance ctx holds the previous P and rotation; first run initialises them to the current values
delta = (P - Pprev) * strength
default path (m_flStartTime_min >= 1): per particle f = min(curTime - creationTime, dt) / dt; d_i = delta * f

if m_flRange != 0: g = min(1, |pos + d_i - P| / m_flRange); with b = m_flRangeBias (collection input, Schlick bias as for float inputs: b<=0 -> 0, b>=1 -> 1, else g/((1-g)(1/b-2)+1)); d_i *= (1 - bias(g))
!m_bLockRot: pos += d_i * m_vecScale; if m_flPrevPosScale != 0 and m_nFieldOutputPrev != 19: prev += d_i * m_vecScale * m_flPrevPosScale
m_bLockRot: the particle is also carried by the rotation delta Rcur * inverse(Rprev) about P (0x18035d240 invert, 0x18035c9a0 concat); exact per-component form UNSETTLED (decompile only)

age-window path (m_flStartTime_min < 1): per frame random start/end in [min,max] shaped by the _exp values (thread RNG 0x18036ba50 / 0x18036bf70, exponent * 4.0 as int); w = 1 - clamp((n - start)/(end - start), 0, 1) with n = age/lifetime, skipped (w = 1) when the CP moved more than m_flJumpThreshold (compared against the SQUARED move distance); d_i scaled by w. m_flJumpThreshold is used only on this path.
store P and rotation for next frame
ppo = m_flParticlesPerOrbit; if !m_bEvenDistribution or ppo == -1: ppo = (float) active particle count; step = 2pi / max(1, ppo)
per particle: counter (per-instance, starts at 0, ++ before use; reset if it would overflow); angle = counter * (m_bEvenDistribution ? step : T[c910++]*2pi)
ring point q = (R cos(angle), R sin(angle), 0), R = m_flInitialRadius; q = AngleMatrix(m_flPitch, m_flYaw, m_flRoll) * q (0x18035c380, 0x18035ec80)
thickness: u_i = T_i*0.9999 + 0.0001 (3 draws, c910 += 3); z = 2u0 - 1; phi = 2pi*u1; rr = m_flThickness * u2^(1/3); q += rr*(sqrt(1-z^2) cos phi, sqrt(1-z^2) sin phi, z)
world: p = CP.rotation * q * CP.scale + CP.position (transform from m_TransformInput)
velocity: dir = normalize(p - CP.position); v = speedMin + (speedMax - speedMin)*T[c910++]; prev = p - dir * v * coll.prevDt(+0x68); m_bXYVelocityOnly -> prev.z = p.z

math: per-instance state {t, step, cachedN}; N = m_flNumToAssign; when N changes: step = N > 1 ? 1/(N-1) : 0 (x segment count with CP pairs)
S = CP[start].pos at creation time + m_vStartPointOffset; E = CP[end].pos at creation time + m_vEndOffset

mid: if m_nMidControlPointNumber < 0: M = S + (E-S)*m_flMidPoint; m_nBulgeControl 0: M += (rand*2-1)*m_flBulge per axis (T[c914+0..2], fixed per collection); 1 (start CP) / 2 (end CP): M += forward/|forward| * |E-S| * m_flBulge * (1 - |dot(normalize(E-S), forward)|); else M = 2*CP[mid] - 0.5*(S+E) (so the curve passes through the mid CP)
M += m_vMidPointOffset
p = quadratic Bezier lerp(lerp(S,M,u), lerp(M,E,u), u) with u = t (with m_bCPPairs: start = startCP + dir*int(t), u = frac(t))
p += (-D + 2D*r_i) per axis, D = m_fMaxDistance, r = T[c910+c914+0..2], c910 += 3; writes Position and Position Previous
m_bSaveOffset: attr15 = (u, startCP, endCP)
t += step; if step > 1e-5: snap t to P if |t-P| < 1e-5 else to 0 if |t| < 1e-5 (P = 1, or the CP-pair count)
